phases.name: human-receipt
command:
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';import {validateAuthorQualityHumanReview,authorQualityHash} from './scripts/narrative-author-quality-contract.mjs';
const base='tests/acceptance/narrative-world/';const read=p=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(base+p,'utf8'));const packet=read('raw/author-quality-20261016-v1/blind-packet.json');const review=read('author-quality-human-review-20261017-v1.json');validateAuthorQualityHumanReview(review,packet);const result={schema:'storyforge.narrative-author-quality-human-receipt-validation',version:1,packetHash:authorQualityHash(packet),humanReviewPath:base+'author-quality-human-review-20261017-v1.json',humanReviewSha256:createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(base+'author-quality-human-review-20261017-v1.json')).digest('hex'),shapeAndOutputBindingsValid:true,observedScores:review.judgments.map(x=>({label:x.label,consistency:x.consistency,motivation:x.motivation,acceptance:x.acceptance,consistencyChange:x.consistencyChange,hardContradictionCount:x.hardContradictions.length,editRecord:x.editRecord,elapsedSeconds:x.elapsedSeconds})),accepted:false,boundary:'Checks existing explicit human evidence and exact output binding. Does not score prose, fabricate edits/time, or complete overall quality gates.'};writeFileSync('/tmp/nw-canonical-cpu-validation-20261017-v1-human-validation.json',JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
